raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: The pie chart represents the distribution of a certain quantity across three different years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three slices, each corresponding to one of the years. The largest slice, representing 2019, occupies 46% of the chart and is colored blue. The second largest slice, representing 2018, takes up 33% of the chart and is colored orange. The smallest slice, representing 2017, accounts for 21% of the chart and is colored green. Each slice is labeled with the year it represents, the percentage it occupies, and the absolute number in parentheses. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way, such as being exploded, offset, or bolded. The segments appear to be ordered in descending size, starting with the largest slice for 2019, followed by the second largest for 2018, and the smallest for 2017.
